q1.sampleAnswer: Because the student never failed and only cared about being good at it.

keyPoints.descZh: 学生从没失败过，只在乎自己擅长
examples: Because the student never failed and only cared about being good at it.

q1.rubricZh: 要点：学生从未失败/只在乎擅长。
q1.explanationZh: 作者认为，一个人从没失败过，可能成不了专家。学生只满足于“我擅长”，没想过遇到困难还会不会坚持，所以作者失望。

evidence.quote: he may not become an expert if he never fails

q2.sampleAnswer: He tried again two years later and was accepted.

keyPoints.descZh: 两年后再次尝试并被录取
examples: He tried again two years later and was accepted.
He waited for two years and tried again.

q2.rubricZh: 要点：再次尝试（并被录取）。
q2.explanationZh: 朋友被拒后很伤心，但不想放弃。他等了两年又申请了一次，这次被录取了。

evidence.quote: He waited for two years and tried again.

q3.sampleAnswer: It made him feel he had nothing to learn and he didn’t care about others’ views.

keyPoints.descZh: 觉得没什么可学、不在意别人的看法
examples: It made him feel he had nothing to learn.
He didn’t care about others’ views on his articles.

q3.rubricZh: 要点：觉得无需学习/不在意别人的看法。
q3.explanationZh: 作者年轻时老师总夸他，他不用努力就拿高分，于是觉得没什么可学，也不在意别人的意见，进步就慢了。

evidence.quote: I felt I had nothing to learn about writing.

q4.sampleAnswer: Yes, because it helps us learn and grow. When we fail, we understand our mistakes and learn to keep trying, which makes success sweeter. (Any reasonable answers are acceptable.)

keyPoints.descZh: 表明观点并给出合理理由
examples: Yes, because failure helps us learn from our mistakes.
No, because some people succeed without failing.

q4.rubricZh: 要点：给出明确观点和合理理由即可（Any reasonable answers are acceptable）。
q4.explanationZh: 这是开放题，只要观点明确、理由合理就可以。文章认为失败能让人成长，也能让人更努力。

evidence.quote: That was when I really started to grow.
